title: onprem/airgap: vendor offline bundle + rke2/flatcar distro support + helm/terraform installer fixes
author: Asha Patel
description: Vendor offline bundle updates and distro support: This PR updates the on-prem/airgapped installer to include a curated offline bundle that vendors container images, OS assets, and helm charts required to install Redwood Private in disconnected environments. It adds first-class support and validation for RKE2 and Flatcar edge cases encountered during our early customer onboarding runs, fixes several Helm chart templating issues for TLS and affinity, and updates the Terraform modules used by the installer to correctly render VPC peering and route table configuration. Motivation: customers deploying in highly regulated environments require reproducible offline artifacts and tested distro support; previous installer runs surfaced missing images and Helm templating bugs that caused failures on RKE2/Flatcar. This PR bundles the following changeset: 1) offline-bundle generator: adds vendoring for core images (control plane, sidecars, CNI), OS artifacts for Flatcar, and a package manifest for verification; 2) installer upgrade flow: improves checksum-based idempotency and rollback hooks when upgrade fails mid-flight; 3) Helm charts: fixes templating for ingress/tls, anti-affinity rules, and imagePullPolicy defaults; 4) Terraform: fixes module variable handling for multiple AZs and adds optional S3-compatible artifact store support for airgapped installs; 5) e2e validation harness: adds an offline smoke test that runs a minimal RKE2 cluster using kind/ec2-like nodes and validates image provisioning. The description below contains implementation notes, CI outcomes, and merge details.

release_notes: Added official offline bundle for on-prem airgapped installs; first-class RKE2 and Flatcar installer support; Helm chart fixes for TLS and affinity; Terraform module updates for multi-AZ and S3-compatible backends; improved upgrade idempotency and rollback hooks.
notes_for_ops: Operators should regenerate the offline bundle using scripts/generate-offline-bundle.sh before cutting a release, and upload artifacts to the configured S3-compatible store if using indirect airgap. The installer will validate manifest checksums and fail-fast if mismatch detected.
manual_testing: Validated with internal test cluster on RKE2 1.23 and Flatcar stable; exercised upgrade path and rollback scenario by injecting a failed helm release and confirming rollback hooks are run; offline e2e smoke test included in CI
